LESSON: UTSAV FROM OTHER FAITHS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Utsav (Festivals)
Topic 8.1: Utsav from other faiths

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Utsav from other faiths
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why do we celebrate festivals?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity
2. recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity

Teach
• Today’s focus: state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity” using a school example.
• Model B for “state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar

Teach
• Today’s focus: recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar” using a school example.
• Model B for “recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity
• Model 2: recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity
2. Practise: recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Utsav from other faiths.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why do we celebrate festivals?
2. How do festivals enhance social harmony?
3. Why are festivals that fall on Purnima and Amavasya considered more auspicious?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• state the significance of celebrating the festivals for posterity
• recognise special days of the month as per Indian traditional calendar

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
